entities.summary: Anne Akiko Meyers is a Grammy Award winner, and one of the world's most esteemed and celebrated violinists. Renowned as a muse and champion of today's leading composers, she has commissioned, premiered, and recorded a significant body of contemporary violin repertoire. Described by The Strad as “the Wonder Woman of commissioning", Meyers has premiered works by leading composers such as Arturo Márquez, Arvo Pärt, John Corigliano, Eric Whitacre, Mason Bates, Billy Childs, Wynton Marsalis, Morten Lauridsen, Michael Daugherty, Einojuhani Rautavaara, and Philip Glass, among others.
